description: Register of irregularities, open decisions and unverified blocks for the 06:50Z harvest (session-af0789e6). Nothing here blocks publication.

items.title: Gaelic football treated as excluded ("football")
items.detail: The brief excludes 'football' without qualification. This pass reads that literally and leaves OLBG's Gaelic_Football (id 25) listing off the board; the earlier 05:20Z harvest had included five Gaelic football rows tagged ambiguous_exclusion. Reversible with one line in the harvest.

items.title: OLBG start times are rendered in the viewer's zone and run 7–10 minutes late
items.detail: OLBG labels no time zone. For this fetcher the times are US Eastern (UTC-4): NHL 23:30Z appears as "19:37", NBA 23:00Z as "19:10". European fixtures convert exactly (EHF 18:45 CEST = 12:45; Almaty 19:30 = 10:30). The earlier TSV mixed UK and Eastern times; it is kept for audit, superseded.

items.title: Tennis "followed by" matches have no official start time
items.detail: Seven ATP rows and one WTA row are second/third matches on a court. The official orders of play give only the session start (11:30 local) or "followed by"; OLBG's minute-level time for those rows is an estimate and is not confirmed.

items.title: Five late-night WTA rows could not be placed in a tournament
items.detail: Li v Sonmez, Linette v Siniakova, Stoiana v Uchijima, Kawa v Bencic and Jovic v Paolini (22:30–23:00 EDT = Thursday morning in Asia) were absent from both WTA live feeds at 06:53Z because Thursday orders of play were not yet published. Competition, round and time are blank.

items.title: Earlier session memory named the wrong tennis events
items.detail: The 05:20Z pass assumed Vienna/Basel (ATP) and Tokyo (WTA). The ATP "current" page lists Almaty, Brussels and Lyon this week (Vienna/Basel URLs redirect to 2025 archives) and the WTA lists Osaka and Ningbo. All 13 ATP rows and 2 WTA rows were matched to those events instead.

items.title: Team names differ between OLBG and the official source
items.detail: EHF lists "SAH - Aarhus" where OLBG says "Skanderborg Handbold" (same match id 202711020101059). URC lists "Vodacom Bulls"/"DHL Stormers"; OLBG "Bulls"/"Stormers". EuroCup "Riga Zelli" vs OLBG "Rigas Zelli". Names are published as OLBG shows them; the official name is in the verification note.

items.title: Eighty rows have no official confirmation in this pass
items.detail: Volleyball (20), domestic handball (8), non-NHL ice hockey (8), cricket (9 dated + outrights), Basketball Champions League (4), KBL (1), WTA (5), golf/motor/rugby-league outrights. Official pages were either script-rendered, behind cookie walls (pdc.tv), 404 (ice.hockey, volleyball-bundesliga.de, liiga.fi) or too large to page (tauronliga.pl, 16 chunks). Competition, venue and official time are blank for these rows.

items.title: Darts: official PDC schedule confirms the ties but not the day for most
items.detail: The earlier pass read the official PDC schedule article (session structure, 19:00 CEST starts) but recorded "22 or 23 Oct" for most first-round ties. The article could not be re-read in this pass (cookie-consent wall in the text fetcher), so the OLBG day labels remain unconfirmed.

items.title: NZ v India T20 had only non-official sources
items.detail: The earlier verification cited Cricinfo and Wikipedia. Neither is a governing body, so the row is downgraded to unverified and its competition/venue/time are blank until an NZC or BCCI page is read.

items.title: OLBG shows different "most popular" markets for the same event on different pages
items.detail: Chicago @ Toronto appears with a Money Line on /Basketball/4 and a Pointspread on /Basketball/NBA/4; Tappara v Ässät shows Puck Line on one hockey page and Money Line on another. The harvest keeps the first market seen and records the alternative in the row note.

items.title: Tiny tip samples and tied splits
items.detail: Most rows carry 1–3 tips. Two NBA money lines (IND@NO, DAL@HOU) are exact 2-2 ties and four handball rows have "Tie" as the most-tipped selection. Our model shrinks every split toward even money; these rows cannot grade above LOW on tips alone.

items.title: Prices, handicaps and totals are model output, not market data
items.detail: OLBG publishes no odds in the retrieved pages. Every price here comes from tools/originate.py (Beta(2,2)-shrunk tip split, home-field logit shift, 5% hold). HIGH picks carry a disclosed 65% probability floor justified only by the official facts quoted in the written prediction.

items.title: Each OLBG list is a server-rendered first page
items.detail: Every sport page ends in a JavaScript "Load More Tips" control the fetcher cannot press. The second harvest found ~40 events the first missed by reading sub-league pages (NBA, European, NHL, Other), and one WTA tie (Fernandez v Sasnovich) present at 05:20Z was no longer rendered at 06:50Z although it has not been played. The list is therefore a sample of OLBG's card, not the whole card.

items.title: Sandbox HTTP cannot reach OLBG or league sites
items.detail: curl/urllib return exit 000 for olbg.com, nhl.com, nba.com, statsapi.mlb.com. All retrieval went through the agent page tool; scripts/update.py therefore only refreshes its feed inside GitHub Actions.

items.title: Outright-only sports
items.detail: Golf (10), Motor Racing (3), Rugby League (3), plus darts/cricket/rugby-union futures are tournament markets with no two-sided fixture; they sit in the table with no line. Rugby League shows no dated matches at all this week.

items.title: README and legacy builders are out of date
items.detail: README still references build_data_and_site.py, flagged-review.html, methodology.html and js/dashboard.js, none of which the current build produces; four superseded root scripts and data/master_matches.json remain. Three site tracks (feed, board, OLBG audit) overlap. Noted for the next session; not changed here to stay within claimed scope.

items.title: PlusLiga redirected to tauronliga.pl
items.detail: The men's Polish league URL plusliga.pl/games.html now redirects to tauronliga.pl, i.e. the competition name OLBG's rows imply ("PlusLiga") may be stale. Not confirmed either way; volleyball rows stay unverified.
